description: Implement configurable rake/fee functions and integrate them into terminal pot, call threshold, and action-EV calculations with clear site/venue configuration boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: No-rake configuration reduces exactly to base formulas.
Caps/percentage schedules are deterministic and unit-tested.
Decision outputs disclose whether rake is included and which schedule/version was used.

planning.title: Model rake and fee effects in EV/equity thresholds
